items.title: Funds at a licensed institution
items.body: AduPay does not keep your money: it will be held by an e-money institution or bank licensed by the BCEAO.

items.title: A transparent ledger
items.body: Every contribution and payout is recorded in a ledger that members can view and nobody can edit.

items.title: Verified identity
items.body: Tiered identity checks and fraud screening on every payment.

items.title: Your data protected
items.body: Data encrypted and handled under Ivorian data-protection rules (ARTCI).

items.a: Not yet. AduPay is in preparation, with a pilot planned in Abidjan. The demo app works without real money.

items.q: Do I have to change my mobile wallet?
items.a: No. Every member pays from their own wallet or bank account: Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Wave or a bank.
An institution licensed by the BCEAO holds the funds. AduPay keeps the ledger, sends reminders and runs the payouts.

items.q: How much does Pay for cost?
items.a: Our target is a total cost under 3%, shown before every payment. Final prices will be published at launch.

items.q: Who can see my Community Score?
items.a: Only you, by default. It is shared with a licensed credit partner only if you agree, and you can withdraw consent at any time.
